name: selftest
after_selftest_clean
sql: select (select count(*) from public.ten216_watch_log) log_rows, (select count(*) from public.ten216_watch_alerts) alert_rows, (select count(*) from public.ten216_test_polls) polls_rows, (select max(observed_at) from public.ten216_test_odds_changes) newest_change

name: cron_runs
sql: select status, return_message, start_time from cron.job_run_details where jobid=(select jobid from cron.job where jobname='ten216-collector-watchdog') order by start_time desc limit 3
